usage: The word '組' (zou2) refers to a 'set' in the context of exercises, meaning a group of repetitions performed consecutively.
It is used as a noun to count how many sets of an exercise someone does.
'組' can be combined with numbers to indicate quantity, for example, '三組' means 'three sets'.
In bodybuilding and strength training, tracking how many '組' you complete helps measure workout volume.
You can also use '組' outside exercise contexts when referring to grouped items or units.
